crossRefs.note: “Remember, now, whoever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
“It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.
Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
For Yahweh won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
Yahweh says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have held, to subdue nations before him, and strip kings of…
crossRefs.keyword: help the evil doers. Heb. take the ungodly by the hand

translations.web: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.
translations.bsb: Behold, God does not reject the blameless, nor will He strengthen the hand of evildoers.
translations.kjv: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:
translations.asv: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, Neither will he uphold the evil-doers.
